This game can be linked with up to three other games so that one to four players can compete on the same course.
The players race each other and computer riders.
Three courses are available:-
One Way - Out... One Way - Back. Return - Out & Back. Novice. Intermediate. Advanced.
How to Operate

Lean the bike left or right to change direction. Turn the handlebars to make slight steering changes or to apply counter steering when sliding. Twist the accelerator grip to control the speed,and squeeze the brake lever to reduce speed quickly.
Game Rules

The object of the game is to reach the finish line in the quickest possible time. The game is over when the player reaches the finish line, or the time period reaches zero. The time period is increased each time the player passes a checkpoint Select the course and choice of bike at game start. (In linked mode, the course is decided by the majority of players).
